§. In illo Baptismo præsentes esse debent tres
discipuli sapientum, qui rem rite præstandam

§. [illegible, ~12 letters] Noxii sunt
profelyti Israeli sicut scabies Ievamot fol. 47. 2:
plurimi enim pristinorum morum tenaces, le-
gis Israeliticæ imperiti, dogmata & bonos mo-
res corruperunt.
§.Baptizandus erat profelytus in tali מקוה aqua-
rũ congregatione, quæ aliàs idonea erat ablue-
dæ menstruosæ. (de qua vid. Lavabatur homo.)
§. Alii אותו טבילין ipsum baptizabant, vel הוא
שובל ille ipse se immergebat merstone unâ;
& tali ut & apex digiti capillique perfectè
mergerentur. Nam si quis se totum abluerit,
excepto minimi digiti apice, adhuc immun-
dus censebatur. Maymon. Hal. מקואות c. 1.&.4.
§. In diebus R. Iosuæ Ben Levi conati sunt
quidam extirpare hanc immersionem, fœmi-
narum Galilæarum gratiâ, eo quòd illæ præ
frigore sterilescerent.Hierof.Berac.fol.6.3.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek passages are only approximated; the Hebrew in the §. line after "Noxii" and the Hebrew phrases in the Baptizandus and Alii paragraphs could not be read letter by letter. The Hebrew "קשיים גרים לישראל כספחת" in the line before "Noxii" is printed right-to-left and is shown as illegible. The Hebrew "מקוה", "מקואות" and "הוא שובל" are approximations of the print.
